data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is delighted to present this exceptional 3-bedroom duplex penthouse in DAMAC Bay Tower B, Dubai Harbour, offering breathtaking sea views and an unparalleled waterfront lifestyle.

Property Features:
3-Bedroom Duplex Penthouse
Panoramic Sea Views
Premium Cavalli-Branded Interiors
Private Beach Access
Attractive Payment Plan Available
Prime Location:
5 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah
10 Minutes to Dubai Marina Mall
15 Minutes to Mall of the Emirates
25 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
Convenient access to the Metro and Tram network

Experience luxury living at DAMAC Bay, an iconic waterfront development in the heart of Dubai Harbour. Designed with elegant Cavalli interiors, the development combines sophisticated design with resort-style amenities, private beach access, and stunning marina and sea views. Residents enjoy close proximity to Dubai's finest restaurants, retail destinations, and leisure attractions, making it one of the city's most sought-after addresses.

Contact Provident Real Estate today for more information about this exclusive property, including the payment plan, expected handover, and to arrange a private consultation.
